brands.evidence: Yes, you can open a joint account with Monzo in the UK
Compare Monzo joint accounts with Starling Bank

client_claims.text: Each person gets up to £85,000 in FSCS protection on their share of the balance, meaning up to £170,000 is protected in total on a joint account.
client_claims.note: Fact states FSCS protection is up to £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: Monzo's paid tiers (Extra, Perks, Max) apply to personal accounts
client_claims.note: Plan names match the paid plans listed.

client_claims.text: You can open a joint account only if both have an existing individual Monzo personal account, are 18+, and are UK tax residents.
client_claims.note: No fact covers joint account eligibility.

client_claims.text: Both people get their own distinct white debit card, distinct from the hot coral personal card.
client_claims.note: Card design not covered by facts.

client_claims.text: Both account holders see all joint transactions in real time and receive instant push notifications.
You can create Pots inside the joint account and set up Direct Debits from specific Pots.
Either person can withdraw the full balance or close the account without the other's permission, though Monzo will notify the other person.
